name: fight_act1_windmill_tactician
title: Act 1 fight: the windmill goblins (Tactician)
about: The Tactician variant of fight_act1_windmill: the same fight from the same moment, the same goal and caps, with the game's difficulty at Tactician instead of Balanced (tougher enemies, a smarter enemy AI). Fight (family 1), an Act 1 ambush: the goblins and worgs tormenting the gnome at the Blighted Village windmill, nine enemies with archers on high ground. claude-run-2 S014 won it in 7 rounds with one down (111 party HP lost).

start.needs_save: Act 1, fight_act1_windmill's start moment: its start save Tav-26221264947__SCN-fight_act1_windmill (lsv sha1 ca8dae135db0) loaded with BG3AI_SCENARIO_SETUP=1, the game's difficulty switched from Balanced to Tactician (game menu > Difficulty > Change Difficulty > Tactician > Confirm) and nothing else done: party level 3, companions (Wyll, Gale, Shadowheart). Avatar named Tav (a paladin, Oath of Devotion), Karmic Dice off, Tactician (the difficulty lives in the save), out of combat with no dialogue open, saved as SCN-<name> (docs/SCENARIOS-AUTHORING.md).

note.where: The Blighted Village, east of the windmill; goblins and worgs ahead, out of combat.
note.objective: Defeat the goblins at the windmill.

character.name: Tav
character.brief: A level-headed half-elf paladin (Oath of Devotion), once a Baldur's Gate city watch sergeant: protects the weak, keeps promises, distrusts mind magic and anyone who offers easy power.
